# Sigrid UI

> @acaprino/sigrid: a React UI system in four levels (primitives, components, assemblies and example applications, each an entry of the package or a folder of examples; with the frame of an app and the wiring of a Tauri window beside them), made for coding agents, for apps that run in a browser and in a Tauri window, on a computer and on a phone. ADHD first: calm surfaces, one accent, one clear action at a time. Behaviour from Ark UI and Base UI, form from Park UI recipes, every colour from a theme engine, one icon set (Lucide) the same in every app: an app's own icon is only its mark, and an icon its interface lacks is added to Sigrid.

The paths are relative to the root of the package (in an app: node_modules/@acaprino/sigrid/).

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to build a screen with the toolkit, the rules broken most often, the check to run
- [agents/catalog.json](agents/catalog.json): every component of every entry, with its props and their comments, written from the source
- [agents/examples/tasks.tsx](agents/examples/tasks.tsx): a to-do app in the toolkit's frame
- [agents/examples/mail.tsx](agents/examples/mail.tsx): a mail client in the toolkit's frame
- [agents/examples/workspace.tsx](agents/examples/workspace.tsx): a workspace laid out as Xiox, in the sheet frame
- [agents/examples/triage.tsx](agents/examples/triage.tsx): a screen that fits, whose page never scrolls
- [agents/examples/signup.tsx](agents/examples/signup.tsx): signing in or up, then a first setup one step at a time

## Rules and guides

- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): the rules R1 to R14, the tokens, each component's form
- [docs/patterns.md](docs/patterns.md): the frame of an app, its regions, four screens to start from
- [docs/mobile.md](docs/mobile.md): what the toolkit does on a phone and what an app adds
- [docs/design-laws.md](docs/design-laws.md): how to design and review a screen, law by law, and what is the toolkit's own look
- [README.md](README.md): setup, themes, density, words, icons, the entries of the package

## Optional

- [docs/component-inventory.md](docs/component-inventory.md): each component against Ark UI, Park UI and the rules, with the decisions taken
- [docs/tokens.css](docs/tokens.css): the tokens as CSS variables
- [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md): the libraries the toolkit rests on, their versions and licences
